objective: Cross and normalize TRUE OPEN-to-current movements across 1X2, handicap/DNB, O-U FT, team totals, first-half markets and player props to derive interpretable market-family signals and an OOS-validated Market Confirmation Index.

operational_use_now.reason: weights/correctors are not yet OOS validated

research_queue: Build comparable TRUE OPEN -> intermediate -> pre-XI -> post-XI -> T-40 -> T-30 -> CURRENT -> CLOSE series
Convert prices to de-vigged implied probabilities and compute probability-point deltas
Build Team Strength, Match Goals, Team Scoring, First Half and Player-Specific family features
Run ablation tests against the base model
Estimate weights only on development data
Freeze rules and weights before temporal holdout/OOS
Evaluate Brier, log-loss, calibration, lift, CLV and ROI/yield where valid
Run bootstrap, sensitivity and leave-one-league-out robustness
Promote to operational corrector only if replicably useful OOS
notes: No intuitive fixed weights are operational. Movement remains information, not a standalone betting decision.
